name: Student visa (留学)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires admission to a Japanese university, vocational college, or accredited Japanese-language school.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission to a recognised institution.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires demonstrating sufficient funds (commonly evidenced by a bank statement, scholarship confirmation, or a financial sponsor's declaration and bank statement) to cover tuition and living costs.
requirements.fix_path: Arrange sufficient funds or a sponsor declaration.

evidence_required.document: Certificate of Eligibility application supporting documents (admission letter, financial evidence)

sources.title: Immigration Services Agency of Japan — 留学 (Student) visa

notes: Work rights: up to 28 hours/week with separate 'permission to engage in activity other than that permitted' (資格外活動許可) — a genuinely distinctive administrative requirement not present on most other countries' student routes in this dataset, since the permission is a SEPARATE authorization layered on top of the visa itself, not an automatic entitlement built into student status. No dedicated post-study job-seeking visa/permit was confirmed as currently active during this research pass, unlike UK Graduate, Germany's Job Seeker permit, France's APS, or the Netherlands' Orientation Year — students seeking to stay for work must transition directly to jp_gijinkoku or jp_specified_skilled_worker with a confirmed job offer in hand before their student status expires, a genuinely more time-pressured transition than most other countries in this dataset offer, and a real gap in Japan's Journey chain worth flagging rather than assuming a bridge program exists that wasn't confirmed.
